currentParagraphText: “I’ve just received word from Yggdrasil, and a new declaration of friendship between the Order of the Malefic Viper and Pantheon of Life has been successfully established and shall be announced publicly shortly. Partly because of your banger job as my Chosen on this diplomatic mission. As your Patron, I acknowledge your contributions to the completion of negotiations.”

finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Damn, and I was just about to pry for details I know you aren’t going to give me... oh well, guess we’ll move onto the next order of business,” the Viper said as Jake heard him clear his throat, something that wasn’t a thing with telepathic communication.
